goal: Keep the jet-style kite and its CO2 cartridge launcher deliverable as a legible, correctly scaled tabletop product scene with readable silhouette, panel accents and belly-bay detail
coordinate_system: glTF 2.0 / Blender export: right-handed, Z-up in Blender, Y-up in the glTF file
intended_use: product launch visuals and a web render sheet
audience: product buyers and the design review
visual_targets: readable silhouette in the hero view
subject fully inside the frame in every required view
soft studio lighting with no clipped highlights
matte finish on the skin with panel colour accents legible
belly bay and cartridge detail legible at full-frame
preferences: consistent colour management across views so iterations are comparable

requirements.detail: the hero body must exist in the editable scene
both belly launch bays must exist
loaded and spare cartridge parts must exist
fuselage length is the scaling anchor for the whole scene (measured 2.400 m)
wings carry the panel colour accents the brief asks to read
bay assemblies read as multi-material detail, not a single flat colour
canopy keeps its own transmissive material
the three views the render sheet depends on
the editable delivery file must stay readable as glTF with geometry

views.name: hero
views.purpose: three-quarter hero: silhouette, materials, lighting intent
views.framing: subject fills 45-85% of the frame, no edge clipping

views.name: belly
views.purpose: belly view: launch tubes and cartridge fit
views.framing: belly features centred and fully inside the frame

views.name: bay
views.purpose: bay detail: door, ring and mouth legible at full-frame
views.framing: the bay assembly fills a readable share of the frame

views.name: cockpit
views.purpose: optional cockpit detail for the render sheet

notes: Values verified against the shipped jet-kite.glb (43 mesh objects, 9 materials, 7450 triangles) and against the camera metadata of the existing renders in mcp-demo/ (Cam_Hero, Cam_Belly, Cam_Bay, Cam_Cockpit, scene JetKite, 1200x800).
